exampleEn: To break the ice, I told a funny story at the beginning of the meeting.
exampleKo: 어색한 분위기를 깨기 위해 회의 시작에 웃긴 이야기를 했습니다.
gameExamples: At the party, I played a game to break the ice with new guests.
To break the ice during our first class, the teacher asked everyone to share their hobbies.
He decided to break the ice by complimenting her unique style.
